links.outcome: Meta-analysis conclusion quality with ground-truth retrieved abstracts (Golden-RAG) versus parametric-only generation
links.effect: Golden-RAG consistently and significantly outperformed Parametric-only across models; domain-specific fine-tuning benefits were marginal and neutralized when external material was provided. Best scores were only ~2.7/5.0.
links.quote: Our findings underscore the critical importance of information grounding: the Golden-RAG workflow consistently and significantly outperforms the Parametric-only approach across models.

links.outcome: Whether models identify and reject negated evidence in stress tests
links.effect: All models, regardless of architecture, failed to identify and reject negated evidence, described as a critical vulnerability in current RAG systems.
links.quote: Furthermore, stress tests show that all models, regardless of architecture, fail to identify and reject negated evidence, highlighting a critical vulnerability in current RAG systems.

unlisted_practices: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge evaluation protocol against human expert ratings (Pearson r 0.81)
Domain-specific fine-tuning versus retrieval grounding for evidence synthesis

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on evidence synthesis comparing a retrieval-augmented grounding safeguard workflow (Golden-RAG) against parametric-only generation, as well as testing stress-test vulnerabilities to negated evidence.
